verdict.rationale: Appwrite's first-party Functions docs say functions can be triggered by HTTP requests and SDK methods. Each function runs in its own isolated container with its own URL, in managed runtimes that scale with demand, and can be deployed from source control or the CLI. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of HTTP/SDK invocation and serverless operation (one community comment notes a lack of scaling documentation for cloud functions).

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy server-side functions invoked by HTTP or SDK calls without managing servers

citations.quote: These Functions can be triggered by HTTP requests, SDK methods, server events, webhooks, and scheduled executions.
Run API endpoints, webhooks, cron jobs, and event handlers in secure isolated runtimes that scale with demand.
Each function will have its own URL, execute in its own isolated container
